==Active Ability: Scramble==
[[File:Operator (ROOM) Passive.png|left|thumb|103x103px]]
{{PAGENAME}} has an ability called "Scramble" that teleports enemies back 50% of Lao's Range. This scales with his range, so the more range {{PAGENAME}} has, the further back the enemies are teleported. For example, if he has 10 Range, Scramble will teleport enemies 5 'range' backwards on the Path. Scramble works on all enemies in his range, including Bosses.



* Global Cooldown: 75s
* This ability wont work on enemies that have already been affected by Scramble 3 times.

==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
